# Change notes, last 30 days
In the publisher's own words, newest first. Only notes the publisher wrote are listed: a page can change without one. The exception is the Teal Book (`teal-book`): its publisher's notes cannot be read automatically, so its entries are this tool's own, from comparing each week's text with the last.

- **2026-10-01** Government Functional Standard GovS 005: Digital (`govs-005`, Government Digital Service): This version updates terminology to “government digital and data” where appropriate. It also adds proportionate references to Artificial Intelligence (AI), as well as Knowledge and Information Management throughout the entirety of the Functional Standard. https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/government-functional-standard-govs-005-digital
- **2026-09-30** The Sourcing Playbook (`sourcing-playbook`, Government Commercial Agency): Replaced the Financial viability risk assessment tool https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/the-sourcing-and-consultancy-playbooks
---
